mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 303.5 indicates persistent inflationary pressure, triggering central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL > 303.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, compressing equity multiples and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 303.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400) in a late-cycle expansion signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.7%) indicates labor market tightness that fuels wage growth and inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.7%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening manufacturing output, indicating economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS > 155 million) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 3.7%) indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS > 155000 and UNRATE < 3.7%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.0% during a monetary tightening cycle signals aggressive rate hikes that reduce equity attractiveness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
